notes.title: 🛠️ Bug Fixes Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
I just released an update that fixes some bugs and issues in the game.

A big thank you to everyone who reported problems!
Feel free to reach out if you find anything else or have suggestions.

Have fun and see you in-game!

— Deb

notes.title: ILLUSTRATIONS IN THE DIALOGUES AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone, [i]fake duckies[/i]! [/h1]

[h3]From today you will find a great new feature: the presence of[b] illustrations during dialogues[/b]![/h3]

That's right! This is an addition to the game experience in which, during dialogues precisely, in the most important scenes will be shown the illustrations of the characters with the purpose of becoming more familiar, not only with the story, but with the characters themselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173063/0d194e74a8036dbf30549adca80a03febb0effce.png[/img]

I had a lot of fun drawing all of these scenes, from the most serious to the funniest, so I hope you can really enjoy this addition that I really care about!

[h3][i]Don't forget to leave a review if you are enjoying the game, 
but most importantly... Keep up the fun![/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173063/32f2d14e8fa15f485147de95a9b7031f8f3d7fa6.png[/img]

notes.title: 🎃 Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles - Halloween Update 🎃
notes.content:
[h3]Get ready for a spooky and fun event in Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles! The free Halloween update is available from October 21 to November 4, and it brings some eerie surprises. [/h3]
Here’s what you can expect:

[b]- Halloween-themed Lab:[/b] The lab has been completely transformed with Halloween decorations.

[b]- Exclusive Mission in Monterock:[/b] Get ready for a spooky adventure with the exclusive Monterock mission. You’ll come face to face with some cute but mischievous animated pumpkins—they might look adorable... until they show their bad side! Overcome the challenges and uncover the hidden secrets in this haunted level.

[b]- Final Showdown with Special Boss:[/b] At the end of the mission, take on a unique Halloween boss that will test your skills. Defeat it, and you’ll be rewarded with exclusive items available only during this special event!

[h3]Don’t miss out on the chance to experience the terror and fun in Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles during this limited-time update. Gather your Fake Ducks and get ready for the spookiest adventure of the year![/h3]

notes.title: FREE DEMO AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[h1]FREE DEMO AVAILABLE [/h1]

[h3]I am [i]overjoyed [/i]to announce that the [b]free demo[/b] of “[i]Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles[/i]” is [b]now available![/b][/h3]

You can finally try the game even before you buy it, you will become familiar not only with the gameplay but also with the story of this fantastic adventure!

[i]I hope you will love it and enjoy it![/i]

notes.title: FULL SCREEN PATCH
notes.content:
I have just implemented a feature to improve changing the game window to full screen: simply press F5 and the window will be adapted to your screen, also pressing F6 will change the screen ratio instead.
Thank you for the feedback and I remain available for any other advice or needs! :)
